title: Chetz co-op room
description: Firestore document `coopRooms/{roomId}` for up to four players solving one grid together. Written by Cloud Functions (createCoopRoom / joinCoopRoom / startCoopRoom / leaveCoopRoom / finishCoopRoom / expireRooms); each member may update only its own `members.{uid}.cursor` and `members.{uid}.lastSeenAt`. Grid cells live in the subcollection `cells/{cellIndex}` = {symbol: int 0..31 | null, by: uid, at: ms}, written directly by members.

solutionHash.description: Expected `PuzzleCodec.solutionHash`; null when unknown (completion is then taken on the host's word).

code.description: Six upper-case alphanumerics (`inviteCodes/{code}`) while the room is open or running; null once released.

lastActivityAt.description: Last function-side change; the scheduled `expireRooms` job also counts members' `lastSeenAt` and closes rooms idle for 2 hours.

color.description: Unique within the room; the client colours cursors and cells with it.

lastSeenAt.description: Heartbeat written by the member's client.

cursor.description: Letter-cell index the member is on, written by the member's client.

rewards.description: Set by finishCoopRoom: coins through `users/{uid}/ledger/coop_{roomId}_{uid}`, XP on the user document.
